notes: [FUNCTION] {function-pointer-name-1 | function-prototype-name-1 | intrinsic-function-name-1} [ ( [ {argument-1 | OMITTED} ] ... ) ] - rendered PDF p157: the arguments are bracketed INSIDE the parentheses, so the empty list is legal on both the keyword route (functionCall's functionArgList?) and the keyword-omitted route (subscriptPart : REF_LPAREN subscriptList? REF_RPAREN, kb/Work PB969). An empty group after a DATA reference is refused by name, COBOL2309 (ReferenceResolver.ScreenEmptyParentheses). retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Frontend/Grammar/CobolParserCore.g4#subscriptOrRefMod (kb/Work PB2113: the keyword-omitted argument list is the parsed subscriptPart, whose items are functionArguments)
